notablePrerequisites: You control eight or more Squirrels.
description:
Activate The Unbeatable Squirrel Girl by paying {1}{G}{G}{G}, creating a 1/1 Squirrel creature token for each Squirrel you control.
Activate Supportive Parents four times by tapping eight Squirrels, adding {1}{G}{G}{G}.
Repeat from step 1.
